promise: SpaceX will conduct an uncrewed lunar landing by March 2027
description: The Wall Street Journal reported that SpaceX told investors it will prioritise the Moon before Mars and target an uncrewed lunar landing in March 2027. Musk publicly confirmed the Moon-first strategy, saying SpaceX aims to build a 'self-growing city' on the Moon within 10 years while still intending a city on Mars.
evidence: WSJ report on SpaceX investor communication, February 6, 2026
Musk posts on X confirming the Moon-first strategy, February 8, 2026

role: Sri Lanka Extended Fund Facility arrangement
promise: Provide Sri Lanka about US$3 billion under a 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement approved in March 2023
description: The IMF Executive Board approved a 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement for Sri Lanka of about US$3 billion (SDR 2.286 billion) on March 20, 2023. On May 27, 2026, the Board completed the combined fifth and sixth reviews, enabling an immediate disbursement of SDR 508 million (about US$695 million) and bringing total disbursements to about US$2.4 billion; the remaining reviews continue through the arrangement's term.
evidence: Combined fifth and sixth reviews completed May 27, 2026, releasing about US$695 million
